summary: Max Verstappen converted pole position into victory at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, extending Red Bull's resurgence after implementing a significant upgrade that proved decisive in the intense heat. George Russell's retirement from a competitive position robbed Mercedes of a potential podium finish as the race unfolded amid chaotic delays that tested both drivers and teams. The win moves Verstappen back into championship contention, establishing Red Bull as genuine title challengers heading into the season's critical phase.
